race.description: G.J. Gardiner Homes Dalby & Chinchilla Hcp (58)
race.comment: ZAVEGA (7) was far from disgraced when sixth last start over 1100m at Beaudesert, beaten only 3 lengths. That followed a win at this track the start prior. Finds an easier assignment and can get the job done with the 2kg claim. BEAU'S GIRL (5) showed good early speed and raced just off the lead before lifting to score by 0.7 lengths over 1015m at Toowoomba last start. Going well and should give a bold sight again. SO BE INSPIRED (6) turned in a fair effort at Beaudesert over 1100m at her last run four months ago, finishing fifth and beaten 2 lengths. Can run a race while fresh. IGOTMYMINDONYOU (1) is stepping out at this course for the first time. Last appeared when he scored over 870m at Toowoomba on August 29. Can threaten.
